title: Design: Credit Terms Log load error looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Credit Terms Log cannot be loaded on the test shop.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p1-16-credit-terms-log-could-not-load.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" button beside "New Credit Term".
  2. Click "Audit Log".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The table shows no rows and, in place of the empty line, "Something went wrong loading the Credit Terms Log. Please try again."
  • A red alert at the bottom right with a warning triangle reads the same sentence with "Close"
  • The Credit Terms page behind is unchanged (as in ct-p1-16-credit-terms-log-could-not-load.png).

Step 3:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

The picture's caption says the build differs from the PRD; PRD v3 now says exactly what the picture shows (register CT-D08, settled).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit Terms Log fails to load | "Something went wrong loading the Credit Terms Log. Please try again." | Standard error alert; the table shows no rows and repeats the same sentence in place of the empty-state line”
